producer_semantics.claims: All explicit CLM identifiers, multiple per owned alias. No prose reconstruction.
producer_semantics.questions: Explicit questions and unavailable information as questions.
producer_semantics.status: extracted iff semantic arrays populated, otherwise examined empty.
producer_semantics.refs: Exact supplied applicable evidence IDs only.

auditor_semantics.finding: Fidelity MATCH/DIVERGENCE/OMISSION/ADDITION; unequal original values do not imply divergence.
auditor_semantics.reasoning: Concise source/extraction comparison; no unsupported policy attribution.
auditor_semantics.ref_ids: Every required reference selected from supplied set.

completeness: Every owned alias exactly once. Context excluded. Partial coverage and truncated output not accepted.
reconstruction: Use existing bounded_extraction ledger/hydrate; exact original text and order.
routing: Python stamps identity. Fidelity tasks route no policy rules.

statuses.extracted: accepted extraction; all owned aliases covered
statuses.semantic_refusal: recognized refusal wire; production acceptance remains false
statuses.incomplete: not accepted; coverage or transport incomplete
